subsystems.name: Base language model
subsystems.role: provides the reasoning, language understanding and generation that drive the agent.

subsystems.name: Planner
subsystems.role: breaks a high-level goal into ordered, executable steps.

subsystems.name: Tool interface
subsystems.role: lets the agent act on external systems such as databases, APIs or code runners.

subsystems.name: Memory
subsystems.role: stores context and past interactions so the agent can recall relevant information.

subsystems.name: Execution engine
subsystems.role: runs the loop of plan, act, observe and revise.

subsystems.name: Safety and oversight
subsystems.role: keeps actions within bounds and makes behaviour auditable.

buildSteps.title: Select or train the base model
buildSteps.detail: Begin with a pre-trained large language model; optionally fine-tune it on domain data to improve reasoning and tool use.

buildSteps.title: Define scope and tools
buildSteps.detail: Decide which tasks the agent may perform and expose the necessary APIs with clear, machine-readable schemas.

buildSteps.title: Design the control loop
buildSteps.detail: Implement a loop that generates a plan, chooses a tool, executes it, observes the result, and updates the plan accordingly.

buildSteps.title: Add memory
buildSteps.detail: Give the agent a short-term context window and a long-term vector store so it can retrieve relevant facts across sessions.

buildSteps.title: Implement safety guardrails
buildSteps.detail: Constrain tool permissions, filter harmful outputs, and set hard limits on actions such as spending or data access.

buildSteps.title: Build an evaluation harness
buildSteps.detail: Create test suites of representative tasks to measure success rate, cost and common failure modes.

buildSteps.title: Deploy and monitor
buildSteps.detail: Run the agent with detailed logging, human review of critical actions, and a gradual rollout to catch problems early.

buildSteps.title: Iterate on prompts and fine-tuning
buildSteps.detail: Use observed failures to refine prompts, adjust tool descriptions and retrain the model where needed.

prerequisites.tech: Large language models with instruction following
prerequisites.why: they supply the core reasoning and language capability the agent relies on.
they let the model invoke external actions in a structured way.
they provide long-term memory and grounding in domain knowledge.

prerequisites.tech: Reliable evaluation methods for multi-step tasks
prerequisites.why: it is hard to know whether an agent will succeed on open-ended workflows without extensive testing.
agents can take unintended actions, so guardrails and oversight are still active research.

pathway.milestone: single-agent assistants that use a few tools for narrow tasks such as coding or customer support
pathway.unlocks: automation of routine knowledge work with human oversight.

pathway.milestone: multi-agent systems that collaborate and divide complex goals
pathway.unlocks: handling longer, cross-domain workflows that need different skills.

pathway.milestone: agents that learn from feedback and improve their own behaviour over time
pathway.unlocks: higher reliability and reduced need for constant human correction.

pathway.milestone: general-purpose agents operating across many domains with minimal supervision
pathway.unlocks: broad economic impact, provided safety and alignment challenges are solved.
